main.description: Lists actors named as subjects by the requested DID's follow records. No authentication is required; duplicate relationships are collapsed before pagination, and only the returned actors are hydrated.

actor.description: DID whose outgoing follows are listed.

sortDirection.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A DID or query parameter is invalid.

following.description: Outgoing relationships; each displayed DID identifies the actor named as the follow subject.

totalCount.description: Count of deduplicated relationships before cursor and limit are applied.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor; omitted when no more results are available.
